content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) residue of the FUNWAVE-TVD METEO module: the file contains only comment lines — L1-L11 blank, L12-L55 the Simplified BSD license header (FILE line @L14 names 'mod_storm.F'), L57-L58 module description ('METEO is a module to model wind and pressure effects / it can also provide sources for meteo tsunami and landslide'), HISTORY 05/16/2017 Fengyan Shi @L61, and the closing marker '! end meteo' @L65. No MODULE statement, no declarations, no executable code: the entire module body was removed by the C preprocessor in this build (meteo option not enabled), leaving only comments.

verbatim_spans.text: !  METEO is a module to model wind and pressure effects
!  it can also provide sources for meteo tsunami and landslide

unresolved: The entire METEO module body (declarations, subroutines) is absent from this preprocessed file — only comments survive between the header (L12-L63) and '! end meteo' @L65, indicating the meteo compile-time option was off when build/pre was generated; the actual module content cannot be determined from this file
Header FILE line @L14 says 'mod_storm.F' while the file is named mod_meteo.f90 — source-file naming mismatch
